answer: A fake swarm of identities would need to acquire many jade tokens at real cost, far exceeding any reward. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce, non-transferable credential: each agent must lock a unique jade token minted only through verified proof-of-personhood, and votes are weighted by stake duration. Every epoch, participants broadcast a signed signal from a shared meadow ledger, and duplicated or cloned credentials get slashed, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0033's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
